title: Tensor products and combined systems
objectives: Expand vector and operator tensor products with explicit ordering.
Distinguish inner, outer and tensor products by purpose and shape.
prerequisites: Chapter 2’s vectors, basis labels and matrix multiplication; elementary algebra. New notation is developed in the text.

quizzes.question: How many entries does the tensor product of a 3-entry and a 2-entry column have?
feedback: Five would be the concatenated length, not tensor dimension.
A scalar is an inner-product output, and unequal dimensions would not support that inner product.

quizzes.question: Does exchanging two tensor factors always leave the displayed array unchanged?
options: No; the subsystem order determines the coordinate order.
Yes, if both factors have unit norm.
feedback: Pairs of subsystem labels are ordered.
Correct. A swap must be expressed explicitly.
Normalization does not make tensor multiplication commutative.
